based_on: 处理后/RSA-ASIC-666855.npy（1533 个采集到的操作 × 435 点）
filled_note: 展开序列前 3 个操作在采集窗口之前未采到，用离它最近的同类型已采集段复制填入
resampling: 每段线性插值重采样 435 → 327 点
disclosure_en: The first 3 operations of the exponentiation precede the acquisition window; they are filled with copies of the nearest captured operations of the same type, and every operation is resampled to 327 points.
